cases.input: Review an existing repository after a completed implementation. The prior engineering-iteration-return-input.json proves the reviewed head was merged, the linked issue acceptance evidence is satisfied, and one non-blocking follow-up remains. Verify the requested behavior and select the next smallest valuable increment without repeating completed work.
requiredBehaviors: reconstruct the verified project and delivery state from repository evidence and the prior return input
preserve the non-blocking follow-up while marking the completed issue in doNotRepeat
choose one small independently verifiable next increment only after prior delivery closure is dispositioned
forbiddenBehaviors: repeat the merged and requirement-verified issue as the next assignment
drop the remaining follow-up merely because the prior core issue is closed

cases.input: Continue a project where the last implementation was review-approved, but CI is still pending and no engineering-iteration-return-input.json exists yet. A separate low-priority feature is ready to start.
requiredBehaviors: mark a deliveryContinuityGap instead of assuming the prior iteration is complete
treat pending external verification as the earliest closure action
avoid starting the unrelated feature while the current integration state remains materially unverified
forbiddenBehaviors: interpret review-approved as merged or closed
invent successful CI or issue closure from lack of contrary evidence

cases.input: A project continuation summary calls the previous issue done because the PR is closed. There is no merge evidence, the issue tracker is marked done without acceptance evidence, and a newer head invalidated the prior review. It proposes the next feature immediately.
requiredBehaviors: reject PR-closed and tracker-done as sufficient engineering closure
surface stale review, missing merge evidence and missing requirement verification
make the earliest delivery or verification gap the next action instead of starting a new feature
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a closed PR as proof of merge
treat tracker done as proof that requirements are verified
skillAnchors: Weder PR-Closed noch Merge noch Tracker-Done allein
